title: Fugaro workspace ls
description: The document `fugaro workspace ls --json` and `fugaro workspace show --json` print (docs/workspaces/spec.md §6): one workspace per row, read offline from this machine's own project configs. It is a named set of fields and not a marshalled localcfg.Config, which is the `config list` rule: a marshalled config would publish every key the file happens to carry, and the membership's pin is one of the keys it carries. The pin's assertion key is not a field here at all — a row says a membership is pinned, never what the member's key is. Members are only ever added within a version (D784), so a renamed or re-meant member is a new member under a new name and removing or retyping one bumps version. No object here is closed for that reason: additionalProperties is left true everywhere, because a consumer that refused a member this schema does not know would refuse a newer CLI's document, which the same version promises to keep readable.

version.$comment: workspaceLsDocVersion in internal/cli/workspace_json.go. 2 made job_service_accounts a list of objects and added database_region, the pin's service_address and the owner's shared list; a consumer of 1 read a list of strings there.

workspaces.description: One row per workspace this machine knows, in name order: one its own project config declares here, one a project config here names, or both.

warnings.description: The project configs this read could not use, each naming the config and the loader's own refusal. They are in the document and not only on stderr, because a consumer would otherwise read a short listing as a complete one.

name.description: The workspace's name, which uses the project-name grammar (config.ProjectNameRE, F21).

owner.description: This machine holds the workspace's own project config, which is where the member table, the cap and the shared list are written. It is what makes members readable: false means the members are on the workspace owner's machine and this document says nothing about them, rather than saying the workspace has none.

cap.description: The workspace's own spend ceiling, as this machine's config states it (D1300). Absent when there is none and when owner is false.

members.description: The member table of the workspace's own config here, in name order. [] is a workspace whose table declares no member yet, and null is a machine that does not hold that config at all. A consumer reads owner before it reads this.

shared.description: The credentials the workspace offers, as the owner's own config declares them, in name order (D1298). [] is a workspace that offers nothing, and null is a machine that does not hold that config at all. A member never reads this: a member's runs read the route its own update publishes, so a member holds no copy of the workspace's list.

memberships.description: The project configs on this machine that name the workspace, in name order: the member's own half, which is the key and the pin it carries.

problems.description: The half-done memberships this machine's own files show (W2's two-sided check, as far as this machine can make it): a member the workspace's table here declares whose config here names no workspace, and a config here that names the workspace whose table here does not declare it. Empty on a machine that holds no owner's config.

monthly_usd.description: US dollars a month, the same amount `fugaro workspace cap set --monthly` takes and the unit the config file writes. More than zero: a workspace with no cap leaves the block out rather than stating a zero.

name.description: The credential's name, which is the name the workspace's bundle holds it under and the name the workspace's service speaks. It is a name and never a value: no document here carries a credential.

kind.description: What the credential is for, spelled as the route record spells it (R4). A model credential is offered by name; a forge credential is offered for the repositories it covers.

projects.description: The member projects this credential may be served to, in name order. The effective set is this list intersected with the member's own policy (D1298). It is empty for an entry offered to every member of the workspace, which names no project (all_members): a consumer reads all_members with this field, and an entry that named no project and did not offer it to every member is refused by the writer rather than read as one.

all_members.description: This credential is offered to every member of the workspace, the ones that join later included, and projects is empty beside it (D2977, contract C3's rule 5 of docs/workspace-service/contract-node.md). It is the wider of the entry's two declarations — an entry offered to every member is bounded by the workspace's own ceiling alone — and the two are exclusive: false means the entry is offered to the members projects names.

covers.description: The repositories a forge credential reaches, as owner/name, in the order the owner wrote them. Empty for a model entry, which names no repository, and never empty for a forge one: a forge route is decided per repository, so an entry with no coverage is one the workspace's service could not decide a request against.

project.description: The member's Fugaro project name, which is the key of the owner's table.

job_service_accounts.description: The member's job service accounts: the identities the workspace's service resolves a caller by (spec §5), each with the repositories it is a job of. The service holds a run's verified repository to the calling account's own list, so the two are one statement and an account with no repository is refused at the load (R6, D2992, F42).

database_region.description: The region of the member's Realtime Database, empty for a database in the project's default region. It is not whose database it is: the project is derived from the Firebase project the verified iss names, and this says only where in that project it lives.

firebase_project.description: The member's Firebase project id, which the caller's token is issued under. The member's database URL is derived from it (finding 6) and is not a field here.

fp.description: The member's Fugaro project name, which the token's fp claim must be.

exchange_url.description: The member's exchange endpoint, where the workspace's signer mints a member-bound assertion for.

repos.description: The repositories the member contributes to the workspace, as owner/name. Empty for a member that contributes none.

account.description: One job service account of the member, by its IAM address.

repos.description: The repositories this account is a job of, as owner/name and never a pattern (F42): one for a repository's own job, several for a shared project job. The workspace's service compares a run's verified repository to this list.

project.description: The project config on this machine that names the workspace.

firebase_project.description: The pin's firebase_project: the workspace's Firebase project id, which the token's aud must be.

issuer.description: The pin's issuer, which is exactly https://securetoken.google.com/<firebase_project>.

service_account.description: The pin's service_account: the workspace service account this project's own fugaro update binds its read-only database grant to.

service_address.description: The pin's service_address: where this project's runs call the workspace's own credentials service, empty for a membership that takes no workspace credential (R3). It is the member's own value and is read from the member's file here; nothing the workspace publishes can move it.
